Package bcu.cmp5332.bookingsystem.main

Class Main

java.lang.Object
bcu.cmp5332.bookingsystem.main.Main
public class Main extends Object
Main entry point for the Flight Booking System. Supports both console and GUI modes with user authentication. Features interactive menu system for easy navigation.
Version:
3.0 - Enhanced with menu system and GUI launcher
Author:
Tejindra Rai
